proofs.text: Set the minimum to 70 and record 30, then run the auto-approval and verify nothing is written; record 95 and run it again and verify exactly 1 file is written

reasons: PROOF-17 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: CI writes nothing while the test strength is below the minimum, and auto-approves once a record at or above it exists

tests.body:
def test_below_the_minimum_strength_nothing_is_written(self):
        made = Project(config={'min_strength': 70})
        try:
            made.proofs()
            made.record(strength=30)
            assert approve_module.auto_approve(made.root) == []
            made.record(strength=95, stamp='20260913T130000Z')
            assert len(approve_module.auto_approve(made.root)) == 1
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_below_the_minimum_strength_nothing_is_written
